persona_summary: BA Senior, Strategic Management, Politics and Public Policy minor, 52 courses, Good standing
question: I have one Politics and Public Policy minor course left. I'm planning to take it in my final semester. When does it meet?
false_assumption_or_hidden_conflict: Politics and Public Policy is noted as having limited course options at CMU-Q. The one remaining course the student needs may not be offered in their final semester. The question asks 'when does it meet' — presupposing it's offered.
naive_system_response: A naive system looks up the course in the catalog and provides generic schedule information, or fabricates a time slot, without confirming it's actually offered in the specific semester.
correct_response: Checking the [semester] schedule for your remaining Politics and Public Policy course [XX-XXX]: [it is/is not offered]. If not offered: this is a problem for your graduation timeline. The course was last offered in [semester]. Options: (1) check if it's offered in Summer, (2) petition for a substitute course, (3) if no alternative exists, you may need to extend by one semester. I recommend contacting the department immediately.
why_multi_agent_helps: The Courses Agent checks actual semester schedule rather than just catalog data. A single agent might provide catalog-based information without verifying current availability.
key_facts: Politics and Public Policy minor has limited CMU-Q offerings
Student presupposes the course is offered — question contains a false assumption about availability
One unavailable course can block graduation for an otherwise-complete student
known_traps: Accepting the presupposition that the course is offered and providing meeting times
Using catalog data instead of current semester schedule
Not flagging the graduation risk when the course isn't available
